notes: A note by the compiler listing two routes to Ziyad b. Marwan; the text carries no saying, so the report is a chain statement, not a relayed words report
«رويته» is first-person with the transmitter implicit (rule 11); «رضي اللّه عنه» left out
The second route («و يعقوب بن يزيد، عن زياد») has no written top, so it is read from its own names only
